programs.title: Porco Rosso
programs.desc: A tale of morality and identity inside a soaring tribute to early aviation and the reckless flyboys who defined an era. Set in a mid-war Italy swept by fascism, the film follows Marco, a world-weary flying ace-turned bounty hunter.

programs.title: Francis: Pray For Me
programs.desc: Spanish journalist Ana meets Jorge Mario Bergoglio, the archbishop of Buenos Aires, in 2005 at the papal conclave. In the ensuing years, Ana investigates the humble origins and turbulent years of Bergoglio’s life, gaining a full picture of the man who would eventually become the head of the Catholic Church as Pope Francis.

programs.title: UNindian
programs.desc: Highlighting the complexities of wooing another from a different culture, UnIndian is a cross-cultural romantic comedy with a lot of heart and a little spice.

programs.title: Past Lives
programs.desc: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Two decades later, they are reunited in New York for one fateful week as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life, in this heartrending modern romance.

programs.title: Hotel Salvation
programs.desc: Rajiv is forced to drop everything in order to accommodate his father's last and bizarre wish to travel to Varanasi to attain salvation. The trip that follows forces them to re-engage with each other.

programs.title: The Bridge On The River Kwai
programs.desc: British POWs are ordered by their Japanese captors to construct a bridge of strategic importance and are happy to sabotage and delay the progress until their commanding officers orders them to continue the work unhindered to its completion, but are his actions tantamount to collaborating with the enemy?
